host: Claude Code sandbox (15 GB RAM, 30 GB disk)
note: First in-sandbox run that samples the EFC field parameters (K0, m_sq) DIRECTLY rather than (mu0, Sigma0). Uses vanilla CAMB; mu0 and Sigma0 are diagnostics only, and Alens = Sigma0_eff^2 is the channel through which (K0, m_sq) actually drives the lensing amplitude. Both EFC and GR runs used cobaya minimize with method=bobyqa (2 random restarts). Same priors, same likelihoods.

efc_K0m2.description: Sampled K0 and m_sq directly. Free cosmology. Alens = Sigma0(K0, m_sq)^2 is pushed into vanilla CAMB.

gr_reference.description: Same data, same priors, no K0/m_sq, Alens fixed at 1.0.

delta.comment: Δchi² = -0.30: EFC marginally preferred over GR on the same data. The improvement is dominated by the lensing sector (-0.33), with BAO and lowl TT/EE also slightly preferring EFC. Pantheon+ slightly disfavours EFC (+0.47) because the late-time expansion shift makes the SN distance moduli a worse fit. Net is in EFC's favour. The bobyqa minimum settles at K0 = 1.55, m² = 0.00318 — within 7-9% of the Kill-Test v5 calibration anchor (1.66, 0.0035). The bridge then yields mu0 = 0.944 and Sigma0 = 1.069, both inside the Localization paper's slip window [(0.93,0.96), (1.03,1.07)].

interpretation: First sandbox run where the EFC field parameters (K0, m^2) are sampled directly instead of (mu0, Sigma0). The bridge in tools/cobaya_bridge/bridge_theory.py is responsible for the (K0, m^2) -> (mu0, Sigma0) -> Alens chain, and it is differentiable through cobaya's lambda mechanism.

Δchi² = -0.30 confirms that the K0/m^2 parametrisation does not lose information relative to the previous Alens-free run (Δchi² = -0.70 on lowl + lensing alone). Adding DESI 2024 BAO + Pantheon+ tightens the H0 shift from +2.6 to +0.9 but does not flip the sign.

The bobyqa optimum (K0, m_sq) sits 7-9% below the Kill-Test v5 reference (1.66, 0.0035). That is consistent with the calibration anchor being a single sweet-spot rather than a tightly bracketed posterior peak; the actual best-fit can drift within the slip window without changing mu0 / Sigma0 much.

This run is NOT a substitute for the full plik_lite + DESI BAO + Pantheon+ MCMC over (K0, m^2) using MGCAMB. The sandbox cannot do that because (a) MGCAMB pip wrapper still doesn't push mu0/sigma0 to the Fortran backend, and (b) Planck high-ell plik_lite data is not reachable from this network. The full run remains the next step on a real workstation.
